name: Starbright Village at McKinney Park
when_note: Open nightly from 6 to 10 pm, with a tree lighting on December 3 from 6 to 8 pm.
paras: Starbright Village is the City of Odessa's annual light display at McKinney Park, 625 W. Pool Road. The 27th edition opens December 4, 2026, and runs nightly from 6 to 10 pm through January 3.

The city calls it one of West Texas's favorite holiday traditions, with thousands of lights and festive displays. Admission is free and leashed pets are welcome. A tree lighting on Thursday, December 3, from 6 to 8 pm opens the season.
tip: Tune to the 97 Gold radio station for the event's Christmas music while you walk or drive through.

name: Odessa Parade of Lights
paras: The 31st Annual Parade of Lights rolls through downtown Odessa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6:30 pm. The City of Odessa lists it on its Christmas in Odessa calendar.
Last year's route ran from Odessa College to 3rd Street, so check the city calendar for this year's route before choosing a spot.
tip: Get to the route early and bring chairs for the kids.

name: Santa Land at Starbright Village
paras: Santa Land offers free photos with Santa at Starbright Village in McKinney Park. The city schedules it from 6 to 8 pm on Friday and Saturday, December 11 and 12, and again on December 18 and 19.
The city tells families to bring the whole group and take home a photo with Santa. Admission to the village is free.
tip: Pair the photo with a walk through the lights, which are open 6 to 10 pm.

name: All Aglow at Nicholas Conservatory and Gardens
address: Nicholas Conservatory and Gardens, Rockford, IL 61107
when_note: The lights shine from dusk to dawn.
paras: All Aglow fills the outdoor gardens at Nicholas Conservatory with more than 500,000 sparkling LED lights. The display runs from November 28, 2026, through January 10, 2027, and the lights shine from dusk to dawn.
Admission is free and donations are appreciated. An on-site vendor sells warm drinks for the walk through the gardens.
tip: Dress for the cold and buy a warm drink from the on-site vendor.

name: Holiday Festival of Lights at Sinnissippi Park
when_note: Open Thursday through Sunday evenings through December 13, then daily December 14 to 31.
paras: The Holiday Festival of Lights is a free drive-through display at Sinnissippi Park in Rockford. The 2026 season runs November 27 through December 31, from 5 to 10:30 pm on scheduled evenings.
It is open Thursday through Sunday until December 13 and daily from December 14 to 31. Christmas Eve and Christmas Day stay open 24 hours.
tip: The display's own site, 4thandlights.com, lists the scheduled nights.

name: Tulare County Sheriff's Winter Wonderland
paras: Tulare County Fairgrounds and the Tulare County Sheriff's Office host Winter Wonderland from December 9 to 13, 2026, each night from 5:30 to 9:30 pm. Admission is free and parking is $10.
Each night has a holiday movie and stage performances by local dance and cheer groups. The movies are Santa Clause, The Nightmare Before Christmas, Home Alone, Elf and The Christmas Chronicles.
tip: Parking is $10 per vehicle, so carpool if you can.
